title: A Writer’s Life Is Heading From Book to Screen
summary:
How does a book about someone's life become a film? A new project about writer and activist James Baldwin is beginning that journey.

Higher Ground and Anonymous Content will produce an adaptation of Baldwin: A Love Story, Nicholas Boggs's biography. A biography is a book about another person's life, rather than a book that person writes about themselves.

Boggs and novelist Marlon James have made a deal to adapt the book for the screen. They will also serve as executive producers.

The book uses newly uncovered archival material and fresh reporting. It looks at Baldwin's artistic and personal relationships, including painter Beauford Delaney, his mentor, and collaborators Engin Cezzar and Yoran Cazac.

Higher Ground was founded by Barack and Michelle Obama. Barack Obama has expressed admiration for Baldwin's writing and discussed The Fire Next Time on his book podcast.

Anonymous Content's new leader, Darren Walker, announced the project at a conference on Thursday. The report describes a film being developed, not a completed movie ready to watch. For now, its starting materials are a researched book and a team preparing a screen adaptation.
why_it_matters: A researched biography can become the starting point for a film. This project brings together the book’s author, another writer and production companies.
